subject: Post-discovery: Schedule 60-90m ML/Infra deep dive and agenda
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: Priya Seth <priya@nexahealth.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@nexahealth.com>
Date: Sun, 3 Oct 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery recap + next meeting to lock in (60–90m)

Thanks again for a productive call today — appreciate the level of detail on your inference requirements and the production constraints you highlighted. Quick recap for alignment: 

- Primary goal: move from exploratory tests to a production pilot that serves your real-time triage use case (95th pct latency target < 200 ms).
- Key constraints: PHI handling in VPC, audit logs retention for 1 year, and predictable throughput of ~120 reqs/min during business hours.
- Success criteria for pilot: validated latency at 1k requests, throughput stability, and integration with your KMS for key rotation.

Next step: schedule a 60–90 minute technical deep dive with our ML + infra engineers to scope integration points, quantization/latency tradeoffs, and runbook for deployment. Can you confirm which of these windows work for your team (PST):

1) Tue Oct 12, 10:00–11:30
2) Wed Oct 13, 14:00–15:30
3) Thu Oct 14, 08:30–10:00

If none of those work, send a couple alternatives and we’ll adapt. I’ve attached a short discovery notes PDF and a starter mutual-action-plan CSV to speed things up. 

Agenda we plan to cover (draft):
- 5m: introductions and expected outcomes
- 15m: production goals & constraints (your side)
- 25m: architecture walkthrough (model variants, quantization, KV-cache plan)
- 20m: integration checklist (networking, KMS, logs, compliance)
- 15m: mutual action plan and next steps

I’ll loop in Ben (serving runtime) and Logan (platform/ops) once we lock a time.

Thanks — Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com | +1 (415) 555-0198
Redwood Inference

Attachments: discovery-notes.pdf (summary), mutual-action-plan.csv (stub)

Couple of asks before the session:
- Can you share a short list of the runtime people who will be on the call and their focus areas?
- Any pre-reads you recommend so our infra folks can come prepared?

If Oct 12 is confirmable, please send a calendar invite and we’ll accept.

Best,

Marissa
